yaml.subtitle: Lend a hand to a living botanical garden

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
Arboretum Home The Collection Map Self-guided tour Wellbeing Visit Sponsor a tree Donate Companies Contact Book a visit Español ▸
``` In the world's great arboreta, volunteers are the **heart of the project**: they guide visits, care for the collections, record data, propagate species in the nursery and bring events to life. At the Arboretum of Estancia La Constancia we are **building our volunteer program**, and we invite you to be part of it from the start. ::: {.callout-tip} **The program is taking its first steps.** If you're interested, leave us your details and we'll get in touch to get to know you, tell you about the available tasks and find the best way for you to contribute together. :::
[ I want to volunteer](contact.html){.btn .btn-success .btn-lg role="button"}
Inspired by the volunteer programs of leading arboreta, these are the areas we are opening. For most, no prior experience is needed: we support and train you. ::: grid ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Guides and hosts Welcome groups, accompany tours and share the story of the arboretum. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 📋 Survey and data Map specimens, fill in profiles, measure trees and record phenology (flowering, fruiting). ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Birdwatching Monitoring resident and migratory birds, and logging observations on citizen-science platforms. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 🌱 Nursery and planting Propagating species, sowing, planting and caring for the new collections. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Educational support Assisting with school visits, workshops and activities for all ages. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 📣 Events and outreach Helping with events, social media, photography and communication of the project. ::: ::: ## Who can join? Volunteering is **open to all ages and backgrounds**: students looking for field experience, retirees with time and enthusiasm, nature lovers, teachers, photographers, bird enthusiasts… For many tasks **no prior knowledge is required**; what matters is commitment and a willingness to learn. ## What you'll take away - **Real learning** in botany, ecology, birds and conservation, alongside professionals. - **Community**: being part of a team with purpose. - **Nature and wellbeing**: quality time outdoors. - 📜 **Certificate of participation** recognizing your contribution. - 💚 **Concrete impact**: your work helps conserve and share the natural heritage. ## Frequently asked questions ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Do I need prior experience or training?"} For most tasks, no. We support and train you according to the area you choose. If you already have experience (in botany, birds, education, communication), even better! ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="How much time do I need to give?"} We arrange it around your availability. It can be a one-off day, help at an event, or a more regular involvement. We talk and find the format that suits you. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is there a minimum age?"} Volunteering is open to different ages. If you are a minor or would like to bring a group of young people, write to us and we'll arrange the conditions for taking part. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is there any cost?"} No. Volunteering is a **collaboration**: you give your time and we welcome, train and support you. ::: ## Join in Tell us who you are, what you'd like to do and your availability. We'll reply shortly to take the first step together. ::: {.cta-container style="text-align:center; margin:1.5rem 0;"} [ I want to volunteer](contact.html){.btn .btn-success .btn-lg role="button"} ::: **Email:** [laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com) **WhatsApp:** [+54 9 11 5736 0940](https://wa.me/5491157360940)
